findings: Fingerprint bypass: IP+User-Agent deduplication is a soft barrier. A voter switching networks or User-Agent can vote again; the server blocks it but operators should understand this is rate-limiting, not hard deduplication.

voteResults stub has requireAuth: GET /vote/results redirects to the public /vote page but is guarded by requireAuth, making the route unreachable by the audience it nominally serves. Consider removing the route or dropping its auth guard.
